messages:
emma.c: hey team — Emma here, just started on infra. Onboarding question: I need to run acceptance tests that (1) write billing rows to BigQuery dataset billing_exports_v2 in project emma-sbx, (2) sign AMIs and store AMI IDs in the shared infra SSM path in aws acct 555666777888, and (3) use a KMS key in project sec-prod to encrypt small artifacts. Who owns which perms and whats the minimal set I should request? cc @cloud-ops
devex: welcome! :wave: For BigQuery: create a dedicated SA in your sandbox and grant it roles/bigquery.dataEditor on the specific dataset (avoid project-wide). Give your user roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA so CI can impersonate.
raj: For GKE we use Workload Identity — create a k8s service account and bind it to the GCP SA. For AWS AMI/SSM: infra will create a cross-account assume-role in the infra account scoped to ssm:PutParameter on the prefix and ec2:DescribeImages/ec2:CreateTags if signing. If youre uploading images to ECR, scope to the specific repo.
infra-bot: Please file using the cloud-access 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions' template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Include: GCP project id, dataset name, k8s ns + ksa, exact KMS resource name, AWS account id, SSM path, CI identity (OIDC issuer or user), and requested expiry.
ops-oncall: note: sec-prod KMS is sensitive — cross-project grants require manager approval and justification. Our default short-lived window for KMS onboarding is 7 days. Also org policy blocks some regions for AMI signing (confirm region in ticket).
devex: if you want a quick snippet to paste into the ticket: ```bash
# grant your user token-creator on SA
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding emma-billing-sa@emma-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member="user:emma.c@redwood.com" --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
# grant SA dataset edit
bq add-iam-policy-binding emma-sbx:billing_exports_v2 --member=serviceAccount:emma-billing-sa@emma-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
```
raj: sample AWS assume-role inline policy (put in ticket for infra to create): ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["ssm:PutParameter"],
    "Resource":["arn:aws:ssm:us-east-1:555666777888:parameter/infra/onboard/emma/*"]
  },{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["ec2:DescribeImages","ec2:CreateTags"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}
```
emma.c: thanks. Prefer time-limited assume-role sessions for CI (no long-lived creds). Also will need the KMS justification signed off — who should I loop in?
ops-oncall: loop in your manager + security@redwood for KMS approval. Put intended usage, retention, and why the key in sec-prod is required.
emma.c: filed CLOUD-1622: project=emma-sbx, dataset=billing_exports_v2, k8s ns=acceptance, ksa=accept-billing-sa, kms=projects/sec-prod/locations/global/keyRings/test-ring/cryptoKeys/ci-key, aws acct=555666777888, ssm=/infra/onboard/emma/amis, expiry=7d, CI uses GHA OIDC. Marked manager + security approval required. Appreciate the help! :smile:
